feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 14 August 2026 10:43pm
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

West or SW 2 to 4, veering and increasing North or NW 4 occasionally 5 later this morning. Little change thereafter.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight to moderate in places later today and tonight.


##Weather)##

Risk of mist patches at first and patchy light rain, then generally fair from later this morning or early afternoon onwards.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in any mist patches or light rain at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 19°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C

##Warnings)##

Nil.

##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

16°C
